This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER They are heard.
Perused the case diary / challan papers.

This is the third bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as he/she is implicated in connection with Crime No.171/2022 registered at Police Station Ratangarh, District Neemuch (MP)
for offence punishable under Sections 354(2)(D), 292, 500, 376(3) of IPC; Section 67 of I.T. Act and Sections 11/12, 13/14, and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 30.11.2022.

His first application M.Cr.C. No.5659 of 2023 was rejected by this Court vide order dated Yogesh Agrawal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98240388/
1 07.02.2023 on merits, however, with a direction to the learned Judge of the trial Court to call for the forensic report.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: His second application M.Cr.C. No.15452 of 2023 was also rejected vide order dated 25.04.2023, again directing the State to ensure filing of the FSL report at the earliest and a liberty was also reserved to the applicant to renew his prayer if the FSL report is not filed within one month's time.

Counsel for the applicant has submitted that now the FSL report has been filed and there is material discrepancy in the same as from the mobile phone of the prosecutrix's friends nothing incriminating has been recovered.

Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that incriminating photographs of the prosecutrix, who is 16 years old, have been recovered from the mobile phone of the applicant and thus, no case for grant of bail is made out.

On due consideration of submissions and on perusal of the case-diary as also the FSL report, it is found that in the FSL report various nude photographs of the prosecutrix are available, which according to the prosecutrix are the screenshots taken by the applicant while she spoke to him on video call.
In such circumstances, no case for grant of bail is made out.

(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE Pankaj Yogesh Agrawal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98240388/
